fusions.name: Gallop Through
fusions.desc: A blow at full gallop that deals 15 damage, knocks the target 3.5 tiles back and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Wave
fusions.desc: A shockwave from your stride deals 28 damage, ignoring armour, to everything in a cone 6 tiles long. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Breakneck Pace
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Long-Legged Stride

riders.text: and you are gone before the blow lands
and your kicks keep the same pace

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1.
